# Rule A3: Current-rounding (sharing info about the current round elsewhere) is forbidden.
Current-rounding is inherently disruptive to a roleplay environment. - Sharing information your character would not normally have in a round whether in LOOC/OOC chats or on another platform; both are explicitly forbidden. - Streaming your game live to others is allowed, but anyone caught in that same round and watching your stream will be in trouble for it. - It goes without saying that encouraging this behavior will also get you, the streamer, in trouble.
## Examples: Allowed: - Talking on Discord about the manifest that round (this information is already available to anyone in the lobby). - Streaming on Discord or Twitch without interacting with your viewers in-game.
Prohibited: - You just rolled an antagonist role or got converted into one and used LOOC chat to mention it. - [color=#ff0000]This still applies if you do this in front of other people who know about it in-character, as other people can still hear your message through walls. There is zero tolerance for this and you will be punished without warning.[/color] - You told someone else what the current gamemode is when they wouldn't normally have access to that information. - After taking a ghost role or being revived you gave others information you obtained while observing.
[color=#ff0000]This is a high severity rule to break and our staff will have little tolerance for it. Don't test your luck.[/color]
